data.name: Dhanu
data.gender_notes: Dhanu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Dhanu refers to the divine bow of Lord Shiva. It is a symbol of power, strength, and protection. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhanu' which means bow. The name Dhanu carries the meaning “Bow, Vehicle of Lord Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhanu usually hope their child will grow to embody bow, vehicle of lord shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May your life be filled with the power and strength of Lord Shiva's divine bow.
data.etymology: Dhanu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bow, Vehicle of Lord Shiva.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhanu total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dhanu holds significant cultural importance in Hindu traditions, particularly for those following Shaivism (a sect dedicated to Lord Shiva). Lord Shiva is recognized as a powerful deity, god of destruction and creation. He holds a trident, a drum, and a divine bow called Dhanush in his hands. The bow is a symbol of his strength and power. In rituals, Dhanu is also represented as a symbol of Archery representing the God's Cosmic Powers.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Dhanu has deep spiritual significance, as it refers to the divine bow of Lord Shiva, one of the weapons that signifies his power and strength. The use of the bow demonstrates Lord Shiva's skill and mastery, and it serves as a reminder of the importance of mastering various aspects of life to achieve spiritual growth. The symbol also represents the delivery of his cosmic powers in the form of devastating destruction and creation. By having Dhanu as a name, an individual may be thought to have the spiritual qualities associated with this powerful deity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dhanu symbolizes the bow, an instrument of war in Hindu mythology. It represents the power to protect and defend, as well as the determination and focus required to aim and shoot arrows towards one's goals.

historical_references.reference: The Mahabharata, an ancient Indian epic, mentions Dhanu as the name of the divine bow gifted to Arjuna by Lord Shiva. This bow was capable of destroying the entire universe with a single arrow.

In ancient Indian astronomy, Dhanu (Sanskrit for bow) is one of the 27 constellations. This constellation is associated with the lunar mansion Rohini, which is believed to influence prosperity and abundance during its influence.

modern_usage.modern_context: The Hindu name 'Dhanu' has gained modern relevance in various contexts. In the realm of sports, 'Dhanu' is popularly recognized as the name of the traditional bamboo bow used in archery. With the rise of social media platforms and the increasing popularity of archery as a competitive sport, the name 'Dhanu' has become a trending keyword on these channels. Furthermore, in the gaming industry, many popular archery games have adopted the name 'Dhanu' for their bows or bow-wielding characters. For instance, in the game 'Valorant,' the 'Dhanu' is a prominent weapon used by the 'Sova' agent. In the field of astrology, the name 'Dhanu' is associated with the zodiac sign Sagittarius. The general trend of exploring one's astrological identity through social media and various online platforms has led to an increase in the popularity of the name 'Dhanu' in this context as well.
